title: Svelte component contract scan
responsibility: Derives a component’s props, markup output and nested script exports from its source.

inputs.name: scanComponent.code
inputs.description: Svelte source containing script blocks and markup.

inputs.name: scanComponent.name
inputs.description: Component symbol name used to prefix prop inputs.

outputs.name: scanComponent
outputs.description: Export scan containing a component symbol with props and markup output, followed by script exports and sorted unique detected error names. Inline $props object types become fields; named/untyped props remain a single props input.
